request.subject: Can Wolves Really Change Rivers? - part 1: The Park That Lost Its Wolves
request.title: Can Wolves Really Change Rivers? (Part 1/3)
request.description:
Yellowstone's wolves were wiped out, and the park changed without them. Then wolves from Canada were brought back. Should predators be brought back?

Part 1 of 3: Can Wolves Really Change Rivers?

Sources:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_wolves_in_Yellowstone

https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2024/apr/07/yellowstone-research-reignites-debate-over-wolf-ge/

Stock footage: Pexels. Made with AI-assisted narration.

#shorts #truestory

extra_params.video_script: A viral video claims wolves changed the rivers of Yellowstone. To test it, you have to go back a century. Wolves once roamed the park, hunting elk across its valleys. People saw them as pests, and even park rangers hunted them down. By the late 1920s, the last wolves in the park were gone. Without them, elk herds grazed the riverbanks with little to fear. Young willows and aspens were chewed down year after year. Then, about 70 years later, wolves from Canada were brought back. Subscribe so you don't miss Part 2.
